PKSA-xz3r-9gp4-4m1z.reason: symfony/yaml is a direct requirement of MediaWiki core, which pins the version (5.4.x on 1.39 and 1.43, 7.4.x on 1.46); the fix (5.4.54, 6.4.45, 7.4.18) needs a MediaWiki release. In the running wiki the package parses YAML files shipped with MediaWiki and its extensions, files that an admin provides and, in Semantic MediaWiki, the content of schema pages (editable only with the schema edit right). The effect is that a single request process can crash; there is no code execution and no data leak. Check for a MediaWiki release with a fixed symfony/yaml.
